note: the graded episode's service (graded_service.py): public constants only; the hidden episode is episode.json, which only the worker reads. cell_sha256 pins online/rubblecell/, which setup.sh copies from the image's /opt/rubblecell-training/rubblecell/ (the training ground's byte copy of tests/rubblecell/: every file of the grader's cell, the client included); reference_sha256 pins online/reference/, the byte copy of tests/reference/ (the privileged reference program that the oracle's token unlocks); cell_config is grader_config.json, the byte copy of tests/grader_config.json (the offline grader passes that file to the cell as its configuration); env is the offline grader's numerics and rendering environment (the image's thread pins and tests/test.sh's OpenBLAS and NumPy pins). prep_s is the agent's budget on main ([agent] timeout_sec 14400): the episode must be started within it, and the program freezes at its close at the latest; graded_s is the window from the start to the episode's latest end. practice_flag (O13): the graded episode's start writes it, and the training ground ends its missions and refuses new ones once it exists. The freeze (DM3): at the graded start (or at the start window's close) the root supervisor copies submission_dir into record_dir/snapshot_name (no link followed, only the agent's own entries; snapshot_max_bytes = submission_checks.py's MAX_SUBMISSION_MB of 60 MB, main's cap; entries and depth bounded so the copy finishes and stays within the engine's artifact limits).
